title: Agonising Christ, wouldn’t it give you a heartburn on your arse
html_source: Inconsequential rhetoric is introduced. Mr. Dedalus has just opened the bag of winds.

anchor.text: Agonising Christ, wouldn't it give you a heartburn on your arse
anchor.prefix:
